summary: Tested River Traffic Planning feature (Trip / Lock Queue / Meetings / Bottlenecks) end-to-end. All 10 backend pytest tests pass and full Playwright UI walkthrough succeeded after login as chaddillerud@gmail.com.

issues: ETD field uses browser-default datetime-local picker rather than shadcn Calendar component (acceptable but inconsistent with the rest of the app's dark styling).

passed_tests: GET /api/planning/locks returns 27 locks sorted by RM descending (lock_1 first)
POST /api/planning/trip downstream (820 -> 600, 8 kn) -> direction=downstream, lock legs in DESCENDING RM order, destination leg final, distance 220 mi, lock_count >= 9
POST /api/planning/trip upstream (600 -> 820, 6 kn) -> direction=upstream, lock legs in ASCENDING RM order
POST /api/planning/trip without base_speed_knots -> speed_source in {default, ais}
GET /api/planning/lock-queue/lock_2?lookahead_hours=12 -> 200, lock_rm=815.2, queue ordered ascending by eta_minutes, slots 1..N
GET /api/planning/meetings?lookahead_hours=6 -> 200, encounters ordered by time_minutes, types in {head_on, overtake}
GET /api/planning/bottlenecks?hours=6 -> 27 locks sorted by utilization desc, severity in {low,moderate,high}, arrivals_in_window == upstream+downstream
Frontend: /planning route renders behind ProtectedRoute (traffic-planner-page testid)
Frontend: All 4 tabs (trip/queue/meetings/bottlenecks) present and switchable
Frontend Trip tab: 820 -> 600, default ETD -> Plan Trip renders Total 28h 54m, Locks 10, Distance 220 mi and 11 leg rows (10 locks + 1 destination)
Frontend Lock Queue tab: default lock loads (Lock #13 / RM 522.5) - dropdown + lookahead + Load button work, 'No vessels approaching' shown when none in window
Frontend Meetings tab: default 4h auto-load shows 2 head-on encounters incl. M/V RIVER RUNNER vs M/V DELTA QUEEN with RM badge + time badge + advice text
Frontend Bottlenecks tab: 27 forecast cards rendered with severity badges (LOW etc.) and demand stats
critical_code_review_comments: Trip tab default Lock Queue selection is lock_13 (RM 522.5) which is far from the active demo vessels (RM 800/830). Consider preselecting an upstream lock (e.g. lock_2 RM 815.2) so demo data is visible to first-time users.
Departure (ETD) input uses the native datetime-local control instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere - styling inconsistency, low priority.
Meetings tab also surfaces encounters with the user's own simulated vessel ('User2 Boat'); fine, but ensure user-vs-self-encounters cannot occur when the same MMSI shows up twice.
seed_data_creation: None - relied on existing DEMO001/DEMO002 simulated vessels.
context_for_next_testing_agent: River Traffic Planning is fully working. Backend routes mounted at /api/planning/*. Demo vessels DEMO001 (DELTA QUEEN downbound RM830) and DEMO002 (RIVER RUNNER upbound RM800) drive meeting predictions; their default behavior places them only between locks 1-2, so Lock Queue tab default lock_13 shows empty - select an upstream lock to see them. Frontend tabs auto-load via useEffect on switch.
